result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.add_edge()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Add an edge between two existing nodes in the graph. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L936-L1117){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.add_edge( source, target=None, rel=None, weight=None, auto_create_nodes=False, **attributes, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![Add edge](/assets/graphs/add-edge.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="Before: four nodes joined by three edges, C to A to B to D. After: a new edge between the existing nodes C and D, in the accent color, closes the cycle; no nodes are added." width="100%"} Edges connect existing nodes and can optionally carry weights and attributes. Both source and target nodes must already exist in the graph. You can reference nodes by their integer IDs or string labels (if labels are unique). ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [source]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Union[int, str, rust.Edge]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The source node identifier (ID or label). [target]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[Union[int, str]]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : The target node identifier (ID or label). [weight]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[float]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional edge weight for weighted graphs. Ignored if the graph is unweighted. [rel]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional string relationship type for the edge (e.g., 'friend', 'follows', 'manages'). This is a first-class attribute that always appears as the fourth column in edge DataFrames. [auto_create_nodes]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True`, automatically create nodes (with labels) if they don't exist. If `False`, raises an error if source or target nodes don't exist. [**attributes]{.doc-parameter-name} : Arbitrary key-value pairs to store as edge attributes. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Returns self to enable method chaining. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If source or target node doesn't exist in the graph, or if a label cannot be resolved to a node ID. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Nodes can be referenced by the IDs returned when they were created: ::: {#8f07dcfb .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph() graph.add_node(label="Alice") graph.add_node(label="Bob") alice_id = graph.get_id_from_label(label="Alice") bob_id = graph.get_id_from_label(label="Bob") graph.add_edge(source=alice_id, target=bob_id) graph ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` Number of nodes : 2 Number of edges : 1 Directed : False Density : 1.00 Average degree (min, max) : 1.00 (1, 1) Connected : True Number of connected components : 1 Tree : True Bipartite : True ``` ::: ::: If labels are unique, it's usually simpler to reference nodes by label directly. Since `add_edge()` also returns `self`, the whole graph can be assembled in one chain: ::: {#90e2643b .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="Alice") .add_node(label="Bob") .add_edge(source="Alice", target="Bob") ) graph ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` Number of nodes : 2 Number of edges : 1 Directed : False Density : 1.00 Average degree (min, max) : 1.00 (1, 1) Connected : True Number of connected components : 1 Tree : True Bipartite : True ``` ::: ::: IDs and labels can be mixed freely within the same call: ::: {#212345e2 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ec.Graph() graph.add_node(label="Alice") graph.add_node(label="Bob") alice_id = graph.get_id_from_label(label="Alice") graph.add_edge(source=alice_id, target="Bob") graph ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` Number of nodes : 2 Number of edges : 1 Directed : False Density : 1.00 Average degree (min, max) : 1.00 (1, 1) Connected : True Number of connected components : 1 Tree : True Bipartite : True ``` ::: ::: On a weighted graph, `weight=` stores a numeric cost or strength for the edge: ::: {#15fe9025 .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph(weighted=True) .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_edge(source="A", target="B", weight=0.75) ) graph ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=4} ``` Number of nodes : 2 Number of edges : 1 Directed : False Density : 1.00 Average degree (min, max) : 1.00 (1, 1) Connected : True Number of connected components : 1 Tree : True Bipartite : True ``` ::: ::: `rel=` labels the kind of relationship the edge represents, and always appears as a first-class column in edge DataFrames: ::: {#db2034a5 .cell execution_count=5} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="Alice") .add_node(label="Bob") .add_edge(source="Alice", target="Bob", rel="friend") ) graph ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=5} ``` Number of nodes : 2 Number of edges : 1 Directed : False Density : 1.00 Average degree (min, max) : 1.00 (1, 1) Connected : True Number of connected components : 1 Tree : True Bipartite : True ``` ::: ::: Any other keyword arguments are stored as arbitrary edge attributes, alongside `rel`: ::: {#5c70744c .cell execution_count=6} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="Alice") .add_node(label="Bob") .add_edge(source="Alice", target="Bob", rel="friend", since=2020) ) graph ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=6} ``` Number of nodes : 2 Number of edges : 1 Directed : False Density : 1.00 Average degree (min, max) : 1.00 (1, 1) Connected : True Number of connected components : 1 Tree : True Bipartite : True ``` ::: :::
